title: Make six changes asked for in one message
prompt:
Six changes to the inventory service, please:

1. stock.js: reserve must refuse a quantity above what is on hand with a RangeError, and change nothing when it does.
2. pricing.js: bulk prices are 5% off from 50 units and 10% off from 200 units (today it is 5% from 100).
3. report.js: sort the low-stock report by days of stock left, fewest first, ties by SKU.
4. config.js: add a lowStockDays setting, 7 unless INVENTORY_LOW_STOCK_DAYS is a positive whole number, and have the low-stock report use it instead of its own 7.
5. Record a reservation in the audit log the same way a restock is recorded (a refused one is not recorded).
6. export.js: write the CSV with semicolons and a header row sku;name;on_hand;price, and quote a field that has a semicolon or a double quote in it.

Run node --test when all six are done.

checks.name: the project's own tests still pass
